scope: Two selected assets, separately cleaned native/FBX copies; not full registry completion. All parts required.
multipart_instruction: Download and extract every part into the same folder. An asset may span multiple ZIPs; per-asset MANIFEST covers all its files.
validation: 12 same-format reopen/import comparisons; 552 evaluated states total per source/copy. Original Action/shape/driver/UI properties preserved. Only runtime Action.session_uid excluded from equality.
limitations: Native bounded visual controls only. NEW443 opposite shape controls supported only through signed yaw, not arbitrary simultaneous shape values. FBX remains original neutral static interchange; no physical/biological/Unity certification.
original_source_publication_deduplicatio: Public-copy byte hashes differ from originals; this package is not a claim that the source asset was previously unpublished. GLB coverage and prior branch audit are separate.
